findings.evidence: The declaration at line 162 assumes only `[CommRing R]`, while the module text calls its Clifford algebra “the fermionic Fock space”; the roadmap’s corresponding realization is specifically over `ℂ` and via `equivExterior`.
findings.fix: Say only that this is the Clifford algebra carrying the displayed relations, or state the precise hypotheses and referenced equivalence under which it can be realized on an exterior/Fock space.
findings.issue: Lines 23–24 and 159–161 identify the Clifford algebra itself as the fermionic Fock space for arbitrary `CommRing R`; the file constructs no Fock-space/exterior-algebra realization, and such an interpretation needs additional hypotheses and structure.

findings.evidence: `ker_traceAdjointSO` at lines 223–225 proves `(traceAdjointSO R n).ker = LieAlgebra.center R (Matrix n n R)`, and its own docstring explicitly says the map is not injective.
findings.fix: Replace “embedding” with “homomorphism” or “adjoint map” at every occurrence.
findings.issue: The map is repeatedly called an “adjoint embedding” (lines 203, 212, and 219, plus line 81), although its documented kernel is the generally nonzero centre, so it is not an embedding.

summary: The documentation overclaims both the interpretation of the Clifford algebra and injectivity of the adjoint map.
